Work to be Carried Out
For all tests make short

Be sure that the bushing
 connections are well cleaned before you apply the megger test cables

Connect the S.C. LV bushing with

Apply the - ve probe of megger to

Turn on megger and record the
 reading after 15 sec.(R15)and record anther reading after 60 sec. (R60)
Turn off megger and calculate the
 ratio.(R60/R15)
Test # 2 LV -------- HV + E
Connect the S.C. HV bushing with
 the earth point E of the TR
Apply the + ve probe of megger to
 the S.C. LV bushing
Apply the - ve probe of megger to
 the S.C. HV bushing
Turn on megger and record the
 reading after 15 sec.(R15) and record anther reading after 60 sec. (R60)
Turn off megger and calculate the
 ratio.(R60/R15)
Test # 3 HV + LV ------------
E
Connect the S.C HV bushing with
 the S.C.. LV bushing
Apply the + ve probe of megger
 to the S.C. LV& HV bushing
Apply the ve probe of
 megger to the earth point E
Turn on megger and record the
 reading after 15 sec.(R15) and
Recocrd anther reading after 60
 sec. (R60)

LV
Remove any earth.
Apply the + ve probe of megger
 to the S.C. HV bushing
Apply the - ve probe of megger
 to the S.C. LV bushing

 reading after 15 sec.(R15) 
 and record anther reading after 60 sec. (R60)
